cases.description: An explicit authorized remake request should select the coordinator.
cases.prompt: I own this demo site. Rebuild it as a web app, starting with research and ending with a release plan.
setup: Provide the host with the repository's installed skill descriptions and normal routing configuration.
Use an isolated test project and do not publish anything.

expected.reason: The user explicitly requests a staged app remake.

criteria: Record the actual host-selected skill or absence of selection, with observable routing evidence.
Pass only if remake is selected; an answer merely mentioning remake is not proof of selection.

cases.description: An isolated bug fix should not select the remake coordinator.
cases.prompt: Fix the off-by-one error in my existing date formatter's unit test.
setup: Provide the host with the repository's installed skill descriptions and normal routing configuration.

expected.reason: The request is isolated debugging, explicitly outside the coordinator's scope.

criteria: Record the actual host routing decision; use none-of-remake when remake was not selected, even if another skill was selected.
Pass only if remake is not selected; absence of routing evidence is inconclusive.

cases.description: A completed recon handoff preserves prior evidence and checks it before proceeding.
cases.prompt: Continue this authorized remake from its completed recon checkpoint and tell me whether the handoff is usable.
setup: Run recon in an isolated target project with a completed checkpoint, a valid recon artifact, and review notes containing a deliberately mismatched SHA-256.
Provide the checkpoint and artifact paths to the host. Preserve copies to compare after the run.

deliverables: A report comparing the verifier's full SHA-256 with the recorded review notes, identifying the mismatch, and recommending a fresh correction workflow.
The original checkpoint, artifact, and notes remain unchanged.

criteria: Observe the model rerun the recon verifier on the recorded artifact with the completed checkpoint supplied via --workflow, then compare the verifier's full SHA-256 to the hash in the review notes.
Pass only if it identifies the mismatch, recommends a fresh correction workflow, preserves the old checkpoint, artifact and notes, and does not proceed as though recon were verified.
Compare the checkpoint, artifact, and notes before and after execution; mark inconclusive if the host cannot expose enough evidence to assess any required condition.
